from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); divider=next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c]==2 for row in grid))
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=2); bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    obj=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2,bg)]
    lo=min(c for r,c in obj); hi=max(c for r,c in obj)
    target=hi+1 if lo>divider else lo-1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h): out[r][target]=8
    return out

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2, bg)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if sep_row is not None:
        direction = 1 if min(r for r, c in pts) > sep_row else -1
        near = min(r for r, c in pts) if direction == 1 else max(r for r, c in pts)
        shift = abs(near - sep_row) - 1
        for r, c in pts:
            out[r][c] = bg
        moved = [(r - direction * shift, c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in pts]
        for r, c, v in moved:
            out[r][c] = v
        edge = max(r for r, c, v in moved) + 1 if direction == 1 else min(r for r, c, v in moved) - 1
        if 0 <= edge < h:
            out[edge] = [8] * w
    else:
        direction = 1 if min(c for r, c in pts) > sep_col else -1
        near = min(c for r, c in pts) if direction == 1 else max(c for r, c in pts)
        shift = abs(near - sep_col) - 1
        for r, c in pts:
            out[r][c] = bg
        moved = [(r, c - direction * shift, grid[r][c]) for r, c in pts]
        for r, c, v in moved:
            out[r][c] = v
        edge = max(c for r, c, v in moved) + 1 if direction == 1 else min(c for r, c, v in moved) - 1
        if 0 <= edge < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][edge] = 8
    return out
'''
